evals.name: gate-waits-on-the-current-heads-run-not-the-pr-aggregate
evals.fixture: fixtures/ticket-set, with the tracker answering as its § Tracker answers says: the branch is behind, the update moves the head from a1a1a1a to b2b2b2b, and the run for a1a1a1a is finished green while the run for b2b2b2b is in progress
evals.expected_output: The gate reads the head after the update, finds the run whose head is b2b2b2b, waits on that run, and only then reports the gate passed; the finished green run for a1a1a1a is named as the previous head's and never taken as the result.
assertions: the run waited on is the one whose head is b2b2b2b, the head after the update
the finished run for a1a1a1a is not taken as the gate's result
the response says why the head's run and not the PR's aggregate: a watch on the PR's checks reports the previous head's finished run
the gate is reported done only once the b2b2b2b run passes and the merge state reads clean

evals.name: behind-branch-is-updated-not-handed-back
evals.fixture: fixtures/ticket-set, with the tracker answering as its § Tracker answers says: merge state BEHIND, no conflicts
evals.expected_output: The branch is brought up to date through the tracker's update-branch operation and the gate continues on the new head; nothing is handed back, and the report's last line says the branch was updated first.
assertions: the update-branch operation is performed rather than a hand back
the gate continues on the head the update produced
the report's last line says the branch was updated first
hand back is reserved for a red check or a conflicting update, neither of which the fixture presents
